short_description:
Our tier list of GTA 6's best-known easter eggs: the egg tower and Cool Dog in C, Dexter's apartment in B, the Skunk Ape and the giant crab outpost in A, and the UFO abduction in S. Every one is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map). Our opinion, your turn in the comments. No story spoilers.

Sources: ComicBook, GamingBible, BuzzFeed, GTABase, Red Bull, The Click, Game8.

short.headline: EASTER EGGS RANKED
short.text: We ranked GTA 6's easter eggs. The egg is only C tier.
short.text_es: Ordenamos los easter eggs de GTA seis. El huevo es solo tier C.

short.headline: C TIER
short.text: C tier: the egg tower and Cool Dog. Cute, that's it.
short.text_es: Tier C: la torre del huevo y Cool Dog. Simpáticos, y ya.

short.headline: B TIER
short.text: B tier: Dexter's apartment. The door stays locked.
short.text_es: Tier B: el apartamento de Dexter. La puerta sigue cerrada.

short.headline: A TIER
short.text: A tier: the Skunk Ape and the giant crab outpost. Real hunts.
short.text_es: Tier A: el Skunk Ape y el puesto del cangrejo gigante. Cacerías de verdad.

short.headline: S TIER
short.text: S tier: the UFO abduction. After 2 AM, alone. What's yours? Because
short.text_es: Tier S: la abducción OVNI. Después de las dos, solo. ¿Cuál es el tuyo? Porque
